subject: Request for short reference — pick your thank-you (credits, swag, or donation receipt)
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Hernandez <alyssa@brightpark.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for short reference — pick your thank-you (credits, swag, or donation receipt)

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the great conversation last week — BrightPark's integration story was really helpful for our reference program. Would BrightPark be willing to record a short 3–5 minute video (or provide a written quote) about the rollout and the performance improvements you saw? We want to make this as easy as possible.

To say thanks, we can offer one of the following — please pick what works best for you and where we should send it:
- $500 account credit applied to your Redwood invoice
- Swag bundle (hoodie + stickers + laptop sleeve). See attached "swag_options_v3.pdf" for sizes and variants
- A $500 donation to a charity of your choice (we'll provide a tax receipt)

If you choose a donation, could you confirm the recipient charity name and the mailing address or the email where we should send the receipt? If we need a W-9, we can send the form — I attached BrightPark_W-9.pdf in case you want to pre-fill it.

No rush — if you want us to draft a quick script for the video or handle scheduling, happy to coordinate.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: swag_options_v3.pdf (PDF), BrightPark_W-9.pdf (PDF)

From: Alyssa Hernandez <alyssa@brightpark.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for short reference — pick your thank-you (credits, swag, or donation receipt)

Sofia,

Thanks for the note — we'd be honored to do a short written quote (easier on our end). We'd prefer the donation option — BrightPark has a small nonprofit arm, BrightPark Foundation. Can you issue the $500 donation to:

BrightPark Foundation
EIN: 12-3456789
Mailing address: 120 Harbor Way, Suite 200, San Francisco, CA 94105

We will need a formal donation receipt for our records (PDF). If you need a W-9 from us, let me know and I can have our finance team send it — they move slowly so if you can take the lead that helps.

Also quick Q: if the donation takes longer than expected, would you be able to apply the $500 credit in the interim and then convert it to a donation once the paperwork is done? That would be very helpful for our internal tracking.

Appreciate it,
Alyssa Hernandez
Director of Product Operations, BrightPark
alyssa@brightpark.io | (415) 867-2244

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request for short reference — pick your thank-you (credits, swag, or donation receipt)

Marissa, Ben — forwarding Alyssa's reply. BrightPark chooses the donation to "BrightPark Foundation" (EIN 12-3456789). They asked for a PDF donation receipt and asked if we can temporarily apply the $500 credit and later convert to a donation once paperwork is in.

Questions:
- Can Finance issue a donation in the name of their foundation and provide a PDF receipt with our letterhead?
- If donation timing is > 10 business days, can we post a $500 account credit now and reconcile when donation is completed?
- Any paperwork we need from BrightPark (W-9 from them) or forms from us? I attached the template donation_receipt_template.pdf for your review.

Alyssa is on cc on the original thread — she can provide a W-9 from their finance team if needed. Please advise and I'll follow up with Alyssa.

Thanks,
Sofia

Attachment: donation_receipt_template.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Hernandez <alyssa@brightpark.io>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for short reference — pick your thank-you (credits, swag, or donation receipt)

Hi Alyssa — thanks, and please pass along our thanks to the BrightPark team for agreeing to provide a quote. We can absolutely issue the $500 donation to BrightPark Foundation.

Next steps:
1) Could you have your finance team send a completed W-9 (PDF) to accounting@redwood.ai? That will let us process the donation and generate a formal donation receipt on Redwood Inference letterhead.
2) If you'd like the $500 posted as an account credit now, we can do that immediately and then reverse the credit once the donation clears — please confirm if you want that workflow.
3) Donation turnaround is typically 7–10 business days after we receive the W-9 and internal approvals. We'll email the PDF donation receipt to the address you confirm.

If you prefer we can also provide the short written quote now and then send the donation receipt once complete — whichever works best for BrightPark.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (510) 555-0104

Attachment: donation_receipt_template.pdf (PDF)
